name: nepalstay
description: Nepal Stay: website (client) and API server (server).

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "server,client" --prefix-colors "magenta,cyan" --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install --omit=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
